mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has declined monotonically from -41.3% to -36.4% over four weeks, signaling partial return-to-office. This trend will continue, driving weekday commuter retail visits and lifting RETAIL_REC by 4-8 percentage points over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility falls below -42% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines relative to its four-week baseline mean.

When PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week, consumers redirect discretionary time to indoor retail venues, increasing RETAIL_REC by 3-6 points within two weeks.

failure_condition: PARKS mobility recovers by more than 3 points in the first week of the forecast period, or RETAIL_REC does not increase within the two-week window.

failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM recovers to above -26% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases relative to its four-week baseline mean.

The interaction of high residential time and low retail visits creates a regime where consumers are reluctant to leave home; RETAIL_REC will remain depressed (below -42%) over the next four weeks unless RESIDENTIAL falls below 5%.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL-RETAIL_REC spread is 54.1 points at t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 5% in any week, or RETAIL_REC rises above -40% in the first two weeks of the forecast period.

When both series move in tandem with positive slope (improving), commuter-driven retail footfall accelerates. A joint improvement of 2+ points week-on-week in both series will lift RETAIL_REC by 5+ points within two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES and TRANSIT correlation is 0.98 over four weeks
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT declines in the first week, or RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 3 points within two weeks.

Mean reversion over four weeks will produce a positive directional shift in RETAIL_REC of 3-7 points regardless of other mobility drivers, as seasonal demand reasserts.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the prior 28-day mean, or RETAIL_REC falls below -48% in any week.
